result.summary: The application UI appears generally well-structured, but there is one layout inconsistency in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The item appearing at the bottom of the screen (the pizza image) has a '-20%' discount tag that is aligned to the top left of its container, while other similar cards (like Tokumaru Ramen Bar) do not have this overlapping tag style, creating a slight inconsistency in card design language.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent placement and styling of promotional badges across all restaurant cards to maintain a uniform visual hierarchy.
